title: Versus One
description:
Play as giant monsters or as heroes attempting to defeat them in this asymmetric two-player local co-op VR fighting game. Send forth minions and swing massive weapons or rocket jump around the stage and strike at them as they attempt to take you down!

The Hero | PCDemolitionist – Blast through the battlefield with rocket jumps and raining explosives.

Rogue – Swing across the arena with a grappling hook and strike fast with deadly daggers.

 Mage – Distort reality with illusions, blink from place to place whilst beaming down your foes with your arcane might.

The Villain | VRThe Lich King – Hurl searing fireballs, summon spectral skulls, and unleash devastating magic.

The False Angel –Conjure radiant weapons, summon starfall, and skewer your enemies with agonizing thorns.

The Festering Hive – Command swarms of insects, choke the battlefield in vile toxins, and overwhelm all who oppose you.

Game Features• Choose from a roster of unique Heroes and Villains, each with their own abilities and playstyles.

• Battle it out in thrilling asymmetric VR vs. PC battles, with Steam Remote Play letting you play together from anywhere in the world.

• Enjoy expanded combat mechanics that push the limits of typical asymmetric VR fighting games.

• Fight in a destructible environment where every blast leaves its mark.

• Immerse yourself in a unique 2.5D art style unlike anything else seen on VR.
